rawContent: To @msnbc why isn't the clearing of Justin Fairfax name being reported the way the #MeToo          allegations against him were reported? @JoyAnnReid https://t.co/iSWVyL4AwW

@AfricanaCarr Since the #MeToo     started, one of my problems with it has always been giving absolutely cover to the women coming forward. If innocent until proven guilty has any meaning, then the right to confront your accusers should be afforded to the accused.

@GWINNA18 @AfricanaCarr The real victims are hurt when a woman lies about a sexual assault. When you're told by your professor how he determines who gets an A in his office, you walk away thinking who is going to believe me over this established professor. Lies doesn't help #MeToo  credibility.

@thehill No educational value: the Black struggle in the 21st century, #BlackLivesmatter   , the reparations movement, under the "Stop Woke Act" would make White kids feel bad. The struggle against oppression is history. Mitchell doesn't owe DeSantis an apology. The question was fair.
